title: Moment 8: Money, Read-only, always
intro: A short made-up storyboard from endgame.life. Rosa sees where her money goes and cannot lose it by accident. Nothing here is real and nothing is sent.

steps.say: Made-up example, nothing is sent. Rosa sees this month: groceries, rent, supplies.
It found 7 subscriptions, and 2 have gone unused for 90 days.
It flags a charge twice the usual amount.
Access is read-only, so no button here moves money.
